summary: Sysco Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-18, a routine debt or equity shelf takedown with numerous wholly owned subsidiaries (Sysco Cincinnati, Sysco Cleveland, Sysco Columbia, etc.) listed as co-registrants under registration file 333-298926. The excerpt contains only SEC filing-header data—no deal terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics appear. This is an ordinary capital-markets shelf takedown, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle arises; watch only for the eventual pricing terms, use of proceeds, and any guarantee structure tying subsidiary obligors to the parent.
